title: Launch Compass and Telemetry Postcard — Apr 2027 (Draft)
description: Working draft: a compact, operator-friendly checklist (the 'compass') plus a short telemetry postcard for on-shift responders. Purpose is to give a single-page launch orientation for small/medium rollouts where speed matters and signal clarity wins.
compass_checklist: Preflight: Verify staging -> prod PR is merged and tagged (PR #984).
Config: Confirm model routing table pinned to target variant and fallback policy set to 'fallback-lower-cpu' for first 60m.
Capacity: Ensure Dedicated pool has autoscale min=4, max=20; reserved burst enabled. Check GPU health dashboard and node ready count >= min.
Secrets and KMS: Validate KMS key accessible from private-deploy plane; confirm rotation window not scheduled during rollout.
Feature flags: Enable feature-guard for 5% traffic, auto-increment to 25% after 30m if metrics pass.
Rate limits: Confirm quota envelope for canary clients; set emergency throttle channel open for SRE.
Observability: Ensure traces, logs, metrics and slow-query sampling are active. Confirm telemetry postcard subscription list is correct.
Smoke tests: Run canonical smoke suite (see smoke_test_matrix) and attach results to JIRA-RELEASE-7812.
Comms: Post 'go/no-go' in #release-orchestra, ping cross-team owners (Product, SRE, Solutions Eng).
Rollforward/rollback: Confirm rollback playbook link and test hotpatch rollback command on a staging shadow cluster.
Post-launch: Schedule 1h deep dive with product and MLops at T+3h; capture acceptance checklist items.
Sign-off: Primary on-call + release owner must sign-off at each traffic step before ramping.
Housekeeping: Tag release artifacts, update model-catalog entry with new variant notes.
Escalation ladder: SRE -> Platform Lead -> Eng Manager -> CTO on-call contact card confirmed.
telemetry_postcard: Primary signals (must be green): p50 latency, p95 latency, 5m error rate, model quality regression delta on held prompt set.
Secondary signals (watch): per-route token cost, CPU steal on nodes, queue depth > 200ms, stream disconnects.
Alert thresholds: error_rate_5m > 1.0% => page SRE; p95 latency increase > 40% from baseline => investigate; model_quality_drop > 1.5% => pause ramp.
Quick explorer links: latency heatmap, recent traces (last 30m), rollout traffic slice, kv-cache-hit-ratio dashboard.
What to capture on pager: short summary, earliest observed timestamp, rolling % affected, relevant traces IDs, action taken.
Owner assignments: SRE watches infra metrics; Platform watches queue/dispatch; Product watches output quality metrics.
smoke_test_matrix: Endpoint basic: /v1/generate — 3 short prompts, check 200 and response length > 10 tokens.
Streaming: open stream for 2 prompts, ensure chunked frames arrive within 150ms intervals under normal load.
KV cache sanity: warm cache then cold-start a large sequence; measure token latency delta <= 1.5x baseline.
Fallback: simulate GPU pool drain and verify fallback variant responds within 300ms and quality threshold maintained.
Auth: token-based auth with a scoped dev key; ensure no 401/403 in 50 calls.
Billing/usage: exercise embedding endpoint with batch size 16 and confirm usage counters increment appropriately.
Canary traffic: inject 5% traffic slice and confirm no errors for 10m before ramping.
rollout_calendar: Day -2 (2027-04-10): Final staging run, smoke tests, and dry-run rollback. Post results to JIRA-RELEASE-7812.
Day -1 (2027-04-11): Ops preflight meeting 09:00 PT; confirm comms and incident channels. Lock feature flags for rollout window.
Launch Day (2027-04-12): 10:00 PT — enable 5% canary, monitor for 30m; 10:35 PT — review postcard signals and decide ramp.
Launch Day (2027-04-12): 11:00 PT — if green, increase to 25% for 60m. 12:10 PT — if green, increase to 60% for 2h. 14:30 PT — full ramp to 100% with continued sampling.
T+3h (2027-04-12): 17:00 PT — acceptance check-in; gather product sign-off and finalize release notes.
T+24h (2027-04-13): Cleanup: write short post-launch summary in Confluence, close canary ticket, and schedule retrospective if any anomalies.
T+72h (2027-04-15): Run quality sweep on held prompt set and compare to baseline; file regression tickets if delta > 1%.
release_notes_draft: What's new: Model variant 'rwd-v3-compact' routed to production for latency-sensitive routes; fallback policy introduced to preserve availability during GPU contention. Operational changes: new autoscale min/max defaults for Dedicated pools, telemetry postcard for launch responders. Known limitations: canonical prompt-set sees slight style change in low-probability completions — monitoring in place; expected behavior for first 24h. Action items for customers: none required; clients using pinned model versions will continue unaffected. Internal notes: tag this release with 'latency-optimizations-2027-04' and add a short blurb to the status page if we observe any user-facing degradation.
rollout_risks: Model quality regression on long-tail prompts not covered by held set.
Autoscaler oscillation if traffic bursts overlap with pooling window; may cause transient errors.
KMS rotation window colliding with rollout causing temporary auth failures (mitigated by preflight check).
Delayed metric propagation (sampling windows) could hide early regressions — watch raw trace samples.
Human error when flipping feature-guard percentages during busy window.
early_followups: Create short retrospective doc with timeline and signal snapshots T+24h.
If any regressions: create one regression ticket per failing prompt with exact model inputs/outputs and traces.
Audit the rollout automation script for idempotency after this deployment.
Update the public model-catalog entry with brief performance/latency numbers and notes about fallback policy.
